description: Measured equivalences between fast-lane source files. Each entry says a file's new sha256 computes byte-identically to an earlier one; the lane identity hashes the earliest. Append-only. A change that moves any feature byte gets no entry.

equivalences.evidence: Old source 3ba9794 against the new, on 8x B200: the vLLM install check decided identical at 3b, 8b and 70b under unchanged lane ids; reduce_capture gave byte-identical vectors on 64 captured 70B rows (32 native, 32 null); the fast lane gave byte-identical vectors on 8 70B rows with its lane id unchanged; the 128-row spec70 bank of a 70B extension lane, re-banked through the new source after its install check decided identical, was array_equal on 128 of 128 rows under its unchanged lane id; and tests/test_gate_topk_equivalence.py holds the gate top-k equal to its earlier form on tie-forced surfaces.

Old source 3ba9794 against the new, on 8x B200: the vLLM install check decided identical at 3b, 8b and 70b under unchanged lane ids; reduce_capture gave byte-identical vectors on 64 captured 70B rows (32 native, 32 null); the fast lane gave byte-identical vectors on 8 70B rows with its lane id unchanged; the 128-row spec70 bank of a 70B extension lane, re-banked through the new source after its install check decided identical, was array_equal on 128 of 128 rows under its unchanged lane id; and tests/test_gate_topk_equivalence.py holds the gate top-k equal to its earlier form on tie-forced surfaces.

Old source 2c715e0 against the new, on one CPU: tools/fast_reducer_bytes.py dump gave byte-identical vectors on 22 of 22 cases (20,165 coordinates: ExternalSpan at 2 to 129 steps in float32 and bfloat16, with and without the routing family; a random-weight Llama through replay_span cached and full at 2, 3, 4, 17 and 65 tokens and through replay_batch). The change keeps every operator and operand and reuses tensors that depend only on a length or the device; tests/test_fast_ops_equivalence.py holds slope, temporal and the collector equal to their earlier forms. Not yet measured on a GPU.

Old source 2c715e0 against the new, on one CPU, by the same 22-case dump as ops.py's entry: byte-identical on 22 of 22. The high-frequency ratio moves into a method with the same operators, and the diagonal is zeroed through a view rather than fill_diagonal_. Not yet measured on a GPU.

Old source 2c715e0 against the new, on one CPU, by the same 22-case dump as ops.py's entry: byte-identical on 22 of 22. The gate top-k Jaccard counts each adjacent pair's intersection through a membership mask instead of Python sets; tests/test_gate_topk_equivalence.py and tests/test_fast_ops_equivalence.py hold it equal to the set form on tie-forced surfaces and at every set size. Its host transfer moves into a method unchanged. Not yet measured on a GPU.
